committee: *Presentation - Resolution No. 189-38 (LS) - Telo T. Taitague, Chairperson
title: Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Resolution No. 189-38 (LS) , "Relative to posthumously recognizing the late Honorable Franklin Meno Taitague, former Mayor of Inalåhan, for his dedication to the island of Guam; and commemorating his legacy of service; and expressing condolences to his family on his passing on behalf of the people of Guam." The presentation is scheduled for Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 8:30am at St. Joseph Catholic Church, Inalåhan. We look forward to your attendance and participation. Si Yu'os Ma'åse, 2/27/26 1:55 a.m. (FN)
